To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the present organic thin-film transistor properties have a strong dependance on the trap density in pentacene bulk as well as pentacene/di-electric interface.
the photo-response properties of OTFTs are strongly dependent on the trap density in the pentacene film and at the interface of pentace/dielectric.
the photo-responsivity of the organic thin-film transistor is strongly dependent on the trap density and the interface of organic semiconductor/dielectric.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the photo-response properties of organic thin-films transistors with a P(MMA-GMA) modification layer, which is a new type of photo-response device with a simple structure and a high light responsivity.
the photo-response characteristics and their mechanism of OTFTs.
the light responsive properties of pentacene based OTFTs, which is of significance to the development of organic optoelectronic devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present OTFTs can serve as a good model for studying photo-responsivity and photo-sensitivity.

the photo-response mechanism of the present organic photodetectors can be explained by the photogenerated charge carrier transport through the bulk and the interface states, and the trap states at the bulk and the dielectric/organic interface are responsible for the photo-response of the organic photodetector.
the photo-response characteristics can be attributed to the trap density in the pentacene layer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
P(MMA–GA) modification layer is effective in reducing the trap density at both the pentacene/dopant layer and the pentacene/SiO2 interface.
the present photo-response characteristics of organic phototransistors are closely related to the trap densities in the organic thin-film.
a P(MMA-GMA) modification layer can be used to improve the light response properties of OTFTs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the photo-response characteristics can be improved through the modification layer of P(MMA– GMA).
a high responsivity can be achieved in OTFT-based phototransistors with the proper design of gate dielectric and modification layer.
the photo-response characteristics can be controlled by the modification layer.
